title: 2× exception raised without `from` in except block (W0707, first at line 113)
detail: At 2 location(s) (first at line 113), a new exception is raised inside an `except` block without `raise ... from original_exc`. This discards the original traceback and makes debugging harder. Fix: `raise NewExc(...) from exc` to preserve the chain.

title: Line 40: inconsistent return statements — some paths return a value, some don't
detail: The function at/near line 40 has paths that return a value and paths that fall off the end (implicit `return None`). Callers expecting a return value silently receive `None` on the implicit path. Fix: add explicit `return None` or ensure all paths return a consistent type.
